text: Medium: In Java, how do you determine the size of an array named `list`?
explanation: With array variable, length is an attribute or property of array; whereas with String object, length is a method. So we need to use `list.length`.

text: When using the `POST` method in an HTML form, how is the data transmitted relative to the HTTP transaction?
choices: It is appended to the URL as query strings.
It is sent as a block within the HTTP transaction body.
It is encoded into the browser's cookies.
It is sent via a separate FTP connection.
explanation: In the POST method, the data is sent as a block through the HTTP transaction. The data is included in the body of the request.

text: Medium: In Java, are 'constructors' inherited by subclasses?
explanation: Note that constructors are not inherited in subclass.

text: Hard: Which function key is used to close the Site Manager pane in KompoZer?
explanation: You can close the site manager pane by clicking on close button or press F9.

text: Which statement best describes the life cycle of a 'Local Variable'?
choices: Created when object is created, destroyed when object is destroyed.
Created when method/block starts, destroyed when it ends.
Created when class is loaded, destroyed when program ends.
Created when main starts, destroyed when main ends.
explanation: Local variables are created when the method or block is started and destroyed when the method or block has completed.

text: Scientific notation '1.3e12' is treated as which data type by default?
explanation: Scientific notation literals like 1.3e12 are of type double by default.

text: Which CSS tab allows you to set 'Text decorations' like blink or underline?
explanation: Figure 2.5 (Text tab) shows a 'Text decorations' section with checkboxes for Overline, Line-through, Underline, and Blinking.

text: Medium: In a KompoZer table, what is the function of 'Padding'?
choices: Space between text and cell border
explanation: Padding gives a gap between the edge of the cell and the text within it.

text: Hard: What specific JavaScript event handler is used when a user clicks a button?
explanation: click: User clicks on a form element... Event handler: onclick().

text: Medium: What is 'ASCII'?
choices: American Standard Code for Information Interchange
American System Code for Information Interchange
Advanced Standard Code for Information Interchange
Automated Standard Code for Information Interchange
explanation: Based on handwritten note #51: ASCII - American Standard Code for Information Interchange.

text: What is the return type of a Constructor?
explanation: A constructor is a special type of method used to initialize an object. While the text doesn't explicitly state 'no return type', it contrasts it with methods that have return types in the diagrams.

text: Medium: What does the `var` keyword do in JavaScript?
explanation: The script uses `var x = ...` to declare a variable x to hold the field value.

text: In KompoZer, if you select 'internal stylesheet', where is the CSS code placed?
explanation: Figure 2.12 shows the CSS code generated in the head section of the page source code when using an internal stylesheet.

text: What does the '//' symbol represent in Java code?
explanation: A single-line comment begins with double slashes (//).

text: Medium: Which JavaScript event is triggered when an element, such as a radio button, becomes inactive (loses focus)?
explanation: blur: Element such as a radio button becomes inactive.

text: Medium: To insert a table in KompoZer, which menu do you use?
explanation: Go to Insert -> Table. Select single cell table and press OK button.

text: Medium: Which organization sets the standards for the World Wide Web (W3C)?
explanation: Based on handwritten note #12: W3C - World Wide Web Consortium.

text: What is a variable in JavaScript?
explanation: A variable is a container for storing data. Remember, that the variables in JavaScript are also case sensitive.

text: Which open-source WYSIWYG web editor was developed by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)?
explanation: Amaya is another free open source WYSIWYG web editor developed by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).

text: Medium: In CSS syntax `color : green`, what is `color`?
explanation: Declaration consists of a property associated with the HTML element... `color` is the property.

text: What allows you to select multiple items in a form?
explanation: Checkbox: Creates checkboxes in the form. Multiple check boxes can be selected at a time.

text: The 'Action' attribute specifies the filename. When is this file opened?
choices: When the user clicks the submit button.
When the user clicks the reset button.
explanation: This file is opened when the user clicks on the submit button after filling the data in the form.

text: Medium: What does the 'Borders' tab in the CSS dialog allow you to customize?
explanation: To set the border, select the Border tab. This will open the options for the border as shown... width and the color.

text: In the KompoZer 'Table Properties' dialog, what is 'Spacing'?
explanation: Spacing is used to specify gap between cells. (Padding is gap between edge and text).

text: Medium: What does the `names.arg` argument do in the R `barplot` function?
choices: Sets the labels/names for the bars
explanation: `names.arg` to specify the values to be displayed for the bars.

text: Why is Java considered platform-independent at the binary level?
choices: Bytecode interpreters (JVM) exist for different platforms.
explanation: Java is platform-independent at the binary level because the same bytecode can be interpreted by a JVM specific to any operating system (Windows, Mac, Linux).

text: Hard: In the 'Image Properties' dialog, checking 'Don't use alternate text' means:
choices: No text will be displayed if the image fails to load.
The image description is hidden from search engines.
explanation: Specify the alternate text... otherwise select the 'Don't use alternate text' radio button. Giving alternate text will display the text in case the image is not displayed.

text: What keyword is used to declare a class variable?
explanation: Class variables are declared within a class using the `static` keyword.

text: Medium: What is 'TTP'?
explanation: Based on handwritten note #25: TTP - Trusted Third Party.

text: Medium: Which function in JavaScript sets the cursor focus to a specific element?
explanation: The focus method is used to apply focus on a particular element of the form.

text: Medium: Which website is an example of an online bookstore?
explanation: Amazon.com... a good website displaying all the books category wise....

text: What is 'Method Overloading' specifically?
choices: Using different method names for the same task.
Defining methods with the same name but different signatures.
Overriding a method in a subclass.
explanation: In Java, we can have different methods that have the same name but a different signature. This is called 'method overloading'.

text: Medium: In KompoZer, which view allows you to see the source code and the design simultaneously?
explanation: The Split tab displays the HTML source of the current element (alongside the visual design).

text: Medium: When creating a table in KompoZer, 'Width' can be specified in which two units?
explanation: Size: it shows the number of rows... Width of the table. Height and width can be specified in pixels or % of the window.

text: Medium: In the CSS 'Text' tab, which option allows you to underline or blink text?
explanation: Figure 2.5 shows 'Text decorations' with checkboxes for Underline, Blinking, etc..

text: Hard: In a 2-D array declared as `int marks[][] = new int[5][3]`, what does `marks.length` return?
explanation: `marks` refers to the array of rows. There are 5 rows, so the length is 5.

text: What is the correct syntax for a method in UML?
explanation: In UML, operations are declared as: <visibility> <method name> (parameter list) : <return type>.

text: Can you specify the size of dimensions during declaration like `int marks[5]`?
explanation: In Java, we can not specify both the size of dimensions and initial values... Figure 9.4 shows illegal start of expression `int marks[5]`.

text: Which arrow style represents 'Inheritance' (Generalization) in UML?
explanation: Inheritance is represented using an arrow pointing to the superclass (often drawn as a solid line with a hollow triangle head).

text: Hard: What specific value does the `<form>` attribute `action` expect?
explanation: The action attribute is used to specify where to send the form data... It takes a filename as value.

text: Why do we declare the `main()` method as `static`?
choices: To allow it to access instance variables.
To prevent it from being overridden.
To allow the interpreter to invoke it without creating an object of the class.
explanation: The main() method is defined as static so that we can invoke it without creating any object of the class containing the main() method.

text: Hard: What is 'IRCTC'?
choices: Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd
explanation: Based on handwritten note #23: IRCTC - Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd.

text: If 'int a = 17' and 'short b', how must you assign 'a' to 'b'?
explanation: You must use an explicit type cast to convert a larger type (int) to a smaller type (short): b = (short)a.

text: Medium: What is 'BOM' in web browsers?
explanation: Based on handwritten note #8: BOM - Browser Object Model.

text: Medium: What is the difference between `float` and `double` literals in Java?
choices: Float is the default; double requires a suffix.
Double is the default; float requires an 'f' suffix.
explanation: Floating point literal by default is of the type double. To make a literal of type float, we have to append 'F' or 'f'.

text: What base date is used by `Date(long date)` to calculate time?
explanation: The constructor accepts milliseconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 GMT.

text: In the shopping cart JavaScript, how is the 'total' variable calculated?
explanation: The code listing 3.1 shows: `var total = (price * quantity);`.

text: Which access modifier is described as providing 'Friend' like access?
explanation: Protected protection is used to allow access only to subclasses or to share with methods declared as 'friend' (conceptually sharing narrower than public but wider than private).

text: What is 'Multilevel Inheritance'?
choices: A class inherits from multiple classes simultaneously.
A class inherits from a class which inherits from another class.
explanation: Multilevel inheritance is when a class is derived from a derived class (e.g., Employee from Person, Teacher from Employee).

text: Medium: In data compression, what is the 'tar' format on Linux systems?
explanation: The tar file format puts multiple files in a single uncompressed file... (Compression requires gzip/tar.gz).

text: In a UML Class Diagram, which symbol represents 'protected' visibility?
explanation: In UML notation, 'protected' visibility is represented by the hash symbol (#).

text: In the CSS Stylesheets dialog, which tab is used to change font family and size?
explanation: In the Text tab... select the options as per the style required... Font family section... Font size.

text: Medium: In the R language, what is the function `c()` used for?
choices: To create a list or vector of values
explanation: The code `no_students <- c(140, 210...)` shows `c()` combining values into a list.

text: If `r1` and `r2` are distinct objects of class `Room`, what happens if you change `r1.length`?
explanation: Every object has its own set of data. `r1` and `r2` have created two objects using new operator. These objects are allocated different memory space to hold their data values.

text: What does the JavaScript event `onblur` signify?
explanation: Table 2.1: `blur` - Element such as a radio button becomes inactive (loses focus).

text: Medium: What does the term 'Ubiquity' mean in the context of M-Commerce?
explanation: Mobile device enables the user to be contacted at virtually anytime and anywhere. This benefit is known as Ubiquity.

text: Which JavaScript method is used to write content directly to the HTML document?
explanation: The string to be displayed is passed as variable to the method `document.write()`.

text: What is the file extension for a compiled Java file?
explanation: When the program gets compiled... compiler creates a file with extension .class.

text: Medium: What is the difference between the GET and POST methods in HTML forms?
choices: GET sends data as a block; POST appends it to the URL.
GET appends data to the URL; POST sends it as a block.
GET encrypts data; POST does not.
explanation: GET method retrieves data... attaching it at the end of the URL. In POST method, the data is sent as a block through the HTTP transaction.

text: Medium: If you want to put an image in the background of a webpage using CSS, which tab do you go to?
explanation: Note: If you want to keep an image in the background then in the Image option, click on 'Choose file' (inside the Background tab).

text: Hard: In the KompoZer 'Table Properties' dialog, what does 'Spacing' refer to?
choices: Gap between content and cell border
explanation: Spacing is used to specify gap between cells. (Padding is gap between edge and text).

text: What does the 'Split' view in KompoZer display?
choices: Both the source code and the design view
explanation: The Split tab displays the HTML source of the current element (along with the design view context).

text: Which tab allows you to set a background image for an element?
explanation: To set the background color, select the Background tab... If you want to keep an image in the background then in the Image option, click on 'Choose file'.

text: Which attribute of the `<form>` tag specifies the HTTP method to be used when sending data?
explanation: The method attribute specifies the HTTP method to be used when sending the data.

text: Hard: Which CSS tab contains the option to set 'Text Decoration' (like underline or blink)?
explanation: In the Text tab... Text decorations: Overline, Line-through, Underline, Blinking.

explanation: Click on the General tab. This will show the CSS code which is generated as shown in figure 2.10.

text: What is the result of the expression x % y when x=6 and y=-4?
explanation: The result of x%y has the sign of the first operand (x). Since x (6) is positive, the result is positive 2.

text: Hard: Which attribute of the `<table>` tag in KompoZer sets the gap between the cell content and the cell wall?
explanation: Padding gives a gap between the edge of the cell and the text within it.

text: Which property helps in declaring 10 variables at a time of the same type?
explanation: Use of an array helps in declaring 10 variables at a time... instead of `mark1`, `mark2`....

text: What is the file extension for a Java source code file?
explanation: Java source program files must be saved with the extension .java.

text: What does 'Math.sqrt()' return?
choices: The square root of a number
explanation: Function sqrt() is a static method of class Math used to find the square root of a number.

text: Medium: Which tab in KompoZer allows you to view both the design and the source code of the current element simultaneously?
explanation: The Split tab displays the HTML source of the current element (alongside the design view implied).

text: Which package must be imported to use the `Date` class?
explanation: The Date class is provided in the java.util package.

text: Medium: What does the 'Initial Value' field in the 'Form Field Properties' dialog box do?
choices: It sets the default text that appears in the text box when the form loads.
It sets the maximum length of the input.
explanation: In Figure 1.10 caption: 'Here enter text abc@xyz.com in the Initial Value textbox. This will help the user understand the format'.

text: Medium: Which Java operator is used to create a new object?
explanation: Separate memory is allocated when string objects are created using `new` operator.

text: What is the relationship called when a class contains objects of another class?
explanation: Composition and aggregation are the construction of classes that incorporate other objects. They establish a 'has-a' relationship.

text: Medium: What does 'SET' stand for in transactions?
explanation: Based on handwritten note #30: SET - Secure Electronic Transfer.

text: Medium: What is the main advantage of using CSS mentioned in the text?
explanation: CSS allows... Avoid duplication in coding... Use the same content with different styles... Easy maintenance.

text: Which method is used to sort only a range of elements in an array?
explanation: When we invoke this method with 3 arguments: array, start, last; it sorts partial array from element at index start to element at index (last-1).

text: In the KompoZer CSS Stylesheets dialog, under which tab would you find the option to set the 'Opacity' of an element?
explanation: The 'Opacity' slider is located in the Background tab of the CSS Stylesheets dialog box.

text: Medium: What is the specific purpose of the `RationalPlan Multi` version?
choices: To manage interdependent projects sharing common resources.
explanation: RationalPlan Multi allows us to manage projects that share company resources... It allows connections between tasks pertaining to different projects.

text: Medium: What does the `return false` statement do in a form validation script?
choices: It stops the function execution and prevents form submission.
explanation: This is possible by using the return statement. The use of return statement, will stop the function from executing.

text: Which view mode in KompoZer shows the page exactly as it would appear in a browser?
explanation: The Preview mode offers the page view as seen in a browser.

text: Medium: What does the `return false;` statement do in a form validation script?
choices: Prevents the form from being submitted
explanation: The use of return statement, will stop the function from executing... (returning false prevents form submission).

choices: Access educational results, notices, and forms online
explanation: This includes educational institutes and universities, which provides examination results, online enrolment forms....

explanation: Instance variables and instance methods are accessed via objects... referred by using dot (.) operator.

choices: The sender cannot deny sending the message.
explanation: Non-repudiation: It ensures that the sender of the message cannot deny that he/she has sent the message.

explanation: Based on handwritten note #4: IDE - Integrated Development Environment.

choices: If the value is not a number
If the value is a valid number
explanation: One of most commonly used numeric function is isNaN(). NaN stands for 'Not a Number'.

choices: To navigate within the site or between sites.
explanation: Site manager is a powerful tool used to navigate within the site or between the sites.

text: Hard: In M-Commerce, what does the term 'Ubiquity' imply?
choices: The user can be contacted virtually anytime and anywhere
explanation: Mobile device enables the user to be contacted at virtually anytime and anywhere (Ubiquity is listed as a benefit).

text: Medium: What distinguishes 'Marketing and Selling' in E-Commerce from traditional catalogs?
choices: It provides a global reach and interactive product display (video/briefs).
explanation: They provide their product catalogue online... displays different categories of products with images, videos....

explanation: A CSS rule has two main parts: a selector, and one or more declarations.

choices: It limits the number of bars to 1000.
It sets the Y-axis range from 0 to 1000.
explanation: `ylim`... to specify the range of values to be plotted on the Y-axis.

text: Which modifier provides visibility to classes defined in other packages?
explanation: Public provides visibility to classes defined in other package also. To provide public access, use access modifier public.
